title: Fix the ConcurrentModificationException
description: The program should remove all negative numbers from an ArrayList.
expectedBehavior: The program should print [3, 5], with all negative numbers removed.
actualProblem: Modifying an ArrayList (via remove()) while iterating over it with a for-each loop invalidates the loop's internal iterator, throwing a ConcurrentModificationException on the next iteration.
explanation: A for-each loop's iterator does not expect the underlying collection to change mid-iteration. Removing elements safely during iteration requires using the Iterator's own remove() method instead of the collection's.
